quote: Eiffage, through its subsidiary Eiffage Génie Civil Marine, has been awarded, in consortium with the Belgian company Jan de Nul, the design-build contract for the Port of Callao Muelle Norte expansion in Peru. The contract is worth more than €100 million.
note: Opened Eiffage PDF press release 2026-10-02; FX Fed H.10 euro 1.1783 on 16 Apr 2026.
